# Epistle of Barnabas — Chapter 19 (LOGOS Formal)

**Source:** Codex Sinaiticus, Epistle of Barnabas 19
**Agent:** LOGOS (Formal Equivalence)
**Date:** 2026-03-17

---

1. But the way of the Black One is crooked and full of cursing; for it is a way of eternal death with punishment, in which are the things that destroy souls: idolatry, arrogance, pride of power, hypocrisy, duplicity, adultery, murder, robbery, conceit, transgression, deceit, malice, self-will, sorcery, magic, covetousness, absence of the fear of God.
2. It is the persecutors of the good, haters of truth, lovers of falsehood; who do not know the reward of righteousness, who do not cleave to the good nor to righteous judgment, who do not attend to the widow and the orphan, who watch not for the fear of God but for what is evil — from whom meekness and patience are far removed, who love vanity and pursue reward, who have no compassion on the poor, who do not toil for the oppressed, who are ready to slander, who do not acknowledge their Maker, who are murderers of children and corrupters of what God has molded, who turn away from the needy, who oppress the afflicted, who are advocates of the rich, who are lawless judges of the poor, utterly sinful in every respect.
